steps.work: Create, rename, edit, archive and restore user-created courses. Validate input and isolate each course.
steps.source_checks: Empty initial collection and independent course metadata; Archive and restore preserve originals, drafts and layouts across restart; Duplicate names have distinct identities; Invalid input and unavailable-course writes are rejected. Audit and checkpoint.

steps.title: Reusable course modules
steps.work: Persist explicit per-course enable/disable settings for reusable capabilities, without implying future functionality is available.
steps.deliverables: Versioned module catalog and course settings.
steps.source_checks: New courses have no enabled modules or imported content; Module selections persist independently across restart; Invalid module IDs and invalid values are rejected; Disabling modules preserves course data and does not enable providers. Audit and checkpoint.

steps.title: Course portability and permanent deletion
steps.work: Export course records and original bytes with checksums, excluding connection secrets; confirmed permanent deletion cleans linked records and owned files with recoverable failure state.
steps.deliverables: Portable course JSON and retryable deletion.
steps.source_checks: Export includes originals, revisions, drafts, modules and course metadata; Export excludes other courses and connection credentials; Deletion requires exact name and separate backup acknowledgement; Deletion cleans linked records and owned files without damaging another course; Failed deletion remains visible and retryable after restart; unsafe paths rejected. Audit and checkpoint.
